name: nawy-dev-flow
description: Build features in your product's real code as a product manager: a guided setup of your repos, Jira, GitHub, tunnels and reviewer, then /dev-start gives each piece of work its story, branch and own running copy of the repos, /dev-end checks it, opens the PRs and tells your reviewer, and /uat-start and /uat-end test stories on staging and file the bugs.
